heading: Liji 24 · Ai Gong Wen 哀公問 · Questions Of Duke Âi · Ai Gong Wen 11 … Ai Gong Wen 19

items.text: Respect your wife, for she holds the place of hostess in the ancestral rites for your departed parents.
items.quote: the wife was the hostess of the (deceased) parents;--could any husband dare not to show her respect?

items.text: Respect your son as the descendant of your parents and the continuer of your family line.
items.quote: the son was the descendant of those parents;--could any father dare not to show him respect?

items.text: Respect your own person, for you are a branch from your parents; to harm yourself is to wound them.
items.quote: He is in his person a branch from his parents;--can any son but have this self-respect?

items.text: Do all that can be done for your parents, so that by your conduct they are honored as parents of a superior man.
items.quote: he will (at the same time) be able to do all that can be done for his parents.

items.text: Serve your parents with the same reverence and devotion with which you serve Heaven.
items.quote: a filial son serves his parents as he serves Heaven
items.conflict: God alone is to be worshiped; parents must not be elevated to the place of God (Ex 20:3).

items.text: As wife, act as hostess in the ancestral rites for your husband's departed parents.
items.quote: the wife was the hostess of the (deceased) parents
items.conflict: Ancestral rites and offerings to the dead are forbidden (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Enter into the marriage rite so that the generations of your family are continued.
items.quote: By means of the grand rite of marriage, the generations of men are continued through myriads of ages.

heading: Liji 24 · Ai Gong Wen 哀公問 · Questions Of Duke Âi · Ai Gong Wen 1 … Ai Gong Wen 10

items.quote: between father and son there should be affection
between father and son there should be affection

items.text: Honor each other's distinct functions as husband and wife.
items.quote: Husband and wife have their separate functions

items.text: Go in person to meet your bride, showing affection; let respect be the basis of love.
items.quote: the bridegroom in his square-topped cap went in person to meet the bride;--thus showing his affection for her

items.text: Beget children to continue the posterity and provide successors for the sacrifices.
items.quote: to continue the posterity of the former sages, and to furnish those who shall preside at the sacrifices

items.text: Maintain the ancestral temple in good order and reverently offer the seasonal sacrifices.
items.quote: to maintain in good order their ancestral temples; and then at the different seasons of the year reverently to present their sacrifices
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the first commandment; the dead cannot be served.

items.text: Honor the distinction of elder and younger; defer to your elder.
items.quote: distinguishing the positions proper to father and son, to high and low, to old and young

items.text: Maintain the proper distinction between father and son; give honor to your father.
items.quote: distinguishing the positions proper to father and son
